Local government reorganisation

The Local Government Commission will soon be holding in-person community engagement sessions.

These sessions are an important way to share your perspective and reflect on community priorities that will inform future of local government in Southland. There has never been a more important time to have your say.

The sessions begin 27 July and run until 6 August. Find the full list of locations, dates and times of these sessions here: LGC community engagement sessions schedule
